text: The benchmark suite's long-repeats row (ten copies of a 1 MiB unit, 10 MiB, 4 threads) varied by up to 45% in instruction count between runs of one binary at `c9c880d`: perf stat gave 542G, 657G and 789G over three runs, and wall time swung with it. The normal, long-n and protein rows held to 1-2%. That build predates the `f085e43` squash, and nobody has measured the swing on dev.
